title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is a mathematical expression that helps in optimizing the predicted monthly profits. It involves parameters $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$, which need to be adjusted to minimize the function.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_1$$
text: To find the partial derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$, focus on the terms in the objective function that include $$\theta_1$$. Differentiate these terms while treating $$\theta_0$$ as a constant.

title: Calculate the Derivative of Each Term
text: Consider the term $$-\theta_1 x_i$$ in the objective function. What is its derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$?

title: Derivative of the $$\Theta_0 \Theta_1$$ Term
text: Now, consider the term $$\theta_0 \theta_1$$ in the objective function. What is its derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$?

title: Combine the Derivatives
text: Combine the derivatives of the terms $$-\theta_1 x_i$$ and $$\theta_0 \theta_1$$ to complete the gradient vector.
